name: motion-wan-animate-2
title: Motion: move a photo with the motion of a clip on Wan Animate 2
description: Renders the person in your photo with the motion of your clip on Wan Animate 2 Distill in 10 steps. A loop makes chunks of 81 frames and cuts the result to the clip's frame count, at the clip's frame rate, with the clip's sound kept or left out. The node ids are the inner ids of Comfy's template, with its subgraph opened.
